paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 4.3, representing a 0.35 percent increase from the prior close and a 13.58 percent decrease over the past 22 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has recently been in the news due to its partnership with NAES to operate and maintain natural gas generation for its 17-GW Texas data center campus, as reported by Hart Energy on September 29.

The company has filed various forms with the SEC, including a total of 25 filings, with 3 of them being Form 4 filings. Recent filings include a Form PX14A6G on September 11, a Form 3 on September 3, and a Form 8-K on August 31, which announced the scheduling of its first annual meeting of stockholders.
